messages:
olivia-recruiter: Heads-up: panel for candidate P-507 at 2pm — interviewers saying 'no scorecard link' in calendar invite.

sarah-peopleops: Can you paste the invite id and one affected interviewer?

olivia-recruiter: invite-px9, interviewers: @noah-eng-mgr and @leah (they said body blank). Candidates waiting on feedback.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook_delivery id=7aa4 - 202 Accepted then 409 Conflict for invite-px9

maria-hiringops: Looking at ATS audit: scorecard created, enrichment worker attempted twice. Second attempt raised mapping_exists. Likely race from the new parallel enroll flow.

leo-intops: Rolling a 15-minute mitigation: fallback will append scorecard URL to invite body if enrichment not visible after 18s. Deploying now.

noah-eng-mgr: Quick ask: a few interviewers also reported their "trained" badge missing on the panel roster though they completed training yesterday. Possible same root?

maria-hiringops: Training completion event shows up before roster read but there was a cache TTL of 5m. I'll invalidate cache on training webhook and add audit step to checklist.

sarah-peopleops: For now olivia, can you DM the panel the scorecard link and ask them to re-open the invite after patch? We'll add a recruiter UI flag for missing scorecards next sprint.

olivia-recruiter: Done. Sent manual link and asked them to reopen invite. Thanks for the fast response :thumbsup:

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded invite-px9 at 1876543239

leo-intops: Follow-up: I'll file a short postmortem and PR: 1) idempotent enrichment, 2) roster cache invalidation on training writes, 3) UI indicator backlog.

sarah-peopleops: Great. Marking this as recruiting-ops P1 for the sprint.

olivia-recruiter: Closing this thread, panels updated and feedback being collected.
